scope: Actual API/files/initializer modules in an isolated Node VM with a minimal fake DOM; not browser rendering.

cases.name: Root shows two accurate scopes on desktop/mobile and keeps recursive search as default
Nested scope choices stay distinct and mobile whole-share selection preserves the request contract
Root equality follows resolved Windows drive/UNC semantics without prefix or POSIX case guessing
A share selection at root normalizes before rendering even with active search results
API root switch normalizes a nested whole-share selection and synchronizes both selectors
API expansion of the shared root restores the third choice without changing the current directory
File rendering still works when the page-specific scope hook is absent
URL query initializer restores both inputs and preserves query/sort on append
Older recursive search response cannot overwrite the newest response even when fetch ignores abort
Typing invalidates an in-flight recursive search before the debounce fires
Typing invalidates an in-flight current-directory list/filter before debounce
Current-directory HTTP 422 renders failure instead of a successful match count
Current-directory HTTP 503 renders failure instead of a successful match count
Root changed during append discards old offset and refetches the new root from zero
Mobile scope and Enter submit use the same current-directory server search contract
Batch all-success reports four actual deletions and clears only successful selections
Batch first 403 stops writes and truthfully reports failed and unexecuted items
Batch 500 retains its failed selection but continues later successful deletions
Batch network interruption after one success stops and retains failed/unexecuted selections
Batch mixed 200 success:false and HTTP 500 are not counted as deleted
Cancelling the original delete confirmation performs no request and keeps all selections
Real Lan.api.write 401 administrator cancellation stops the batch without false successes
